essence: A great manifested parasol belongs to Mahātripurasundarī.
The very performance of the Vedic sound is invoked to produce blessings.
The stirred atmosphere is wished for the pleasure of the vidyādharīs' dance art.
Even one good fruit cannot be obtained here through countless births.
One who praises the supreme deity may obtain their fruit.
